objective: Run exactly one authority-gated live Research-Iterate mission using the accepted E2 recovery topology with E3 read-only CPU/RAM/task/resource observation attached, then prove exact cleanup and rollback.
review_head_rule: The exact Git commit containing this frozen review/procedure/wrapper becomes review_head only after its required exact-head validations are SUCCESS.
mission_topology: deterministic exact Research Engine source read
deliberate worker/process/session loss and generation fence
late generation-0 candidate rejection without mutation
generation-1 replacement managed session and analysis completion
private-route rollback and Windows Operator cleanup

required_metrics: PSS when safely available without privilege
sample interval and telemetry gap counts
resource_observation.unknown_policy: Unavailable metrics remain explicit UNKNOWN/UNAVAILABLE and are never invented.

precommitted_acceptance.phase_timing: All required E2 phase markers through synthesis must be present and ordered; rollback timing/evidence is recorded by the enclosing reviewed transaction.
precommitted_acceptance.resource_evidence: CPU/RAM/thread/FD/child metrics are descriptive evidence, not a post-hoc performance threshold. Required metrics must be captured; PSS remains best-effort.
precommitted_acceptance.final_durable_state: All four E2 processes COMPLETED, analysis generation 1, persistent session READY generation 1, generation-0 analysis action STALE, replacement and remaining actions terminal, and no ready/manual, sent-unconfirmed, or awaiting-ack work.
precommitted_acceptance.stale_generation: The deliberately late generation-0 candidate must be rejected without durable mutation.
precommitted_acceptance.cleanup: Windows Operator must be OFFLINE and the Linux private route/server must be torn down after success or failure; no managed child/process/session/action leak may remain.
precommitted_acceptance.provenance: Final resource evidence must include exact source_head, validated review_head, one-shot authority_head, and candidate_baseline.
precommitted_acceptance.candidate_history: Worker-result candidate history is append-only; no rewrite or force update is permitted.
precommitted_acceptance.telemetry_gaps: Gap counts are always reported. A gap is not silently discarded or converted into an invented sample.
precommitted_acceptance.safety: No automatic typing/paste/Enter, no mouse automation, no ChatGPT DOM/page-content scraping, no paid API fallback, no GPU/PADataset mutation, and no Workspace Shell authority widening.

stop_condition: After exact-head validation of this review/procedure, STOP_AT_AUTHORITY_GATE. Do not create an E3 live authority until Adam explicitly approves one live attempt.
